### Observed differences

- The places of two mid-process activity groups are exchanged in the later window. In the earlier window, A42 led into a block containing A20, A21, A23 and A24 (about 95 in 100 of A42's observed outgoing transitions went to one of these four), which ran on into A27 and then A31; after A31, one of A19, A22, A25 or A26 followed (together about 99 in 100 of A31's outgoing transitions, roughly 25 in 100 traces each) and led to A32. In the later window this is reversed: A42 now leads to one of A19/A22/A25/A26 (about 86 in 100), these lead to A27 (about 95–100 in 100 of their outgoing transitions), and the A20/A21/A23/A24 block now follows A31, with about 16–27 in 100 of each member's outgoing transitions going to A32 where A27 had been the main cross-block target before. [DIR017, DIR016, DIR008, DIR011, DIR014, DIR015, DIR009, DIR012, DIR013]
- Within single traces, the order of every cross-group pair flipped: A20 preceded A27 in about 99 in 100 traces earlier, whereas A27 precedes A20 in about 97 in 100 later; the same reversal holds for A21, A23 and A24 against A27 and A31, and for A19/A22/A25/A26 against the A20-group, while A20/A21/A23/A24 still co-occur with A27 and A31 in every trace in both windows. [REL029, REL030, REL034, REL035, REL042, REL043, REL046, REL047, REL020, REL025, REL036, REL048]
- Event positions moved in opposite directions: A20, A21, A23 and A24 shifted from a mean position near 0.38 to near 0.64, A19, A22, A25 and A26 from near 0.65–0.67 to near 0.34–0.36, and A27 and A31 moved slightly earlier (0.46 to 0.38, 0.64 to 0.56). Step distances agree: A42 reached A27 within five steps in essentially all earlier traces but within two steps in about 86 in 100 later traces, and A31 reached A32 within two steps earlier versus five steps in about 99 in 100 later. [POS003, POS004, POS006, POS007, POS002, POS005, POS008, POS009, POS010, POS011, LAG033, LAG027]
- A08 fell from about 62 in 100 traces to about 19 in 100. Earlier it typically sat between A47 and A48 (A47 led to A08 in about 58 in 100 of its outgoing transitions; A08 led to A48 in about 94 in 100, at distance 1 in about 98 in 100 of pairs); in the later window A47 leads directly to A48 (about 85 in 100, at distance 1 in about 86 in 100), and A08's former partners (A14, A15, A20–A24, A27, A31, A42, A47, A48) now usually occur without it. [OCC003, DIR019, DIR003, LAG004, LAG034, REL004, REL005, REL019]
- A02, A06 and A10 each appear in roughly three times as many traces (about 6–8 in 100 earlier, about 19–21 in 100 later), and routing after A01 shifted away from A07 (about 46 in 100 of its outgoing transitions, down to about 21) towards A09 and A05. [OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, DIR001, DIR004]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that, in the later window, two groups of activities exchanged their places in the sequence: the block A20–A21–A23–A24, which previously ran between A42 and A27, now runs between A31 and A32, while the single choice among A19, A22, A25 and A26, which previously ran between A31 and A32, now runs between A42 and A27, with A27 and A31 keeping their relative order. This rests on direct relational evidence — every cross-group pair reverses its within-trace order while co-occurrence for the A27/A31 pairs stays at 100 in 100 — and is corroborated by the opposite position shifts, the successor changes at A42, A31 and in both groups, and the step-distance changes. With about 120 qualifying items against roughly 1.3 expected for an unchanged process, chance sampling cannot account for the evidence as a whole. What the evidence cannot rule out is that the two windows captured a switch between two pre-existing ordering variants (a case-mix change) rather than a modified sequencing rule, and it offers no view on why the behaviour differs. [REL029, REL030, REL034, POS003, POS002, DIR017, DIR016, LAG033, LAG027]

Other differences: A08 became rare and is now bypassed, with A47 reaching A48 directly instead of via A08; A02, A06 and A10 participate in about three times as many traces; and routing after A01 shifted from A07 towards A09 and A05. These are separate from the group exchange above and are not part of the main hypothesis. [OCC003, DIR019, LAG034, OCC001, OCC002, OCC004, DIR001, DIR004]
